status: proposed; no live policy or existing strategy changed
recommendation: Replace the permanent one-pick restriction with a shared fight budget and joint payoff allocation after prediction and contract checks. Keep the existing conservative board as the comparison policy while validating the replacement.

priority_order.name: Make exposure consistent across selections
work: Add a new versioned portfolio replay with aggregate fight, card and outstanding-stake limits; preserve existing replay outputs and labels.
Use the same fight identity across moneyline, total lines, methods, books and recording times.
Retain 1% per fight, 5% per card and 10% outstanding as initial conservative comparison caps, not statistically optimized values.
In a tiered comparison, 1%, 2% and 3% are total fight budgets, never independent stakes for every selection. Allow unspent budget. Show planned and capped stakes separately.
Keep separate research experiments separately labeled; adding their returns or allocations together must be an explicit combined portfolio with its own limits.
Include existing open positions before allocating additional stakes; the current snapshot assumption of no open bets is inadequate for repeated betting.

Distinguish hypothetical recorded positions from actual user bets. Actual exposure requires user-entered positions or an explicitly authorized account connection; never infer actual wagers from displayed recommendations.
acceptance: Two 3% proposed selections cannot silently create 6% fight exposure under a 3% fight budget.
Reversed fighter identities, multiple totals lines, repeated snapshots and multiple books all share the same exposure account.
A new capture cannot add another full fight budget to already open positions.

priority_order.name: Preserve one consistent set of fight scenarios
work: Archive winner, method and finishing-time joint probabilities from the existing duration model before results; its interval probabilities already contain useful starting information.
Use the detailed fight simulator only as a separately tested source, not as an assumed reliable joint distribution. A complete simulator rebuild is not required for the first portfolio prototype.
Retain the best accessible fresh quote per identical settlement contract, with stake limits and timestamps; keep inferior quotes only when capacity or settlement differences justify them.

Map every offered bet to win, loss or refund for each complete fight scenario. Include draws, no contests, disqualifications, technical decisions, exact total-line boundaries, cancellations and schedule changes using verified book-specific rules.

Check logical consistency: probabilities sum to one, a named fighter's KO probability cannot exceed that fighter's win probability, and longer-duration totals cannot be more likely than shorter ones. Normal decisions occur at the scheduled end; technical decisions need explicit treatment.
acceptance: All market probabilities are recoverable from the same saved scenario table.
No multiplication of separate moneyline, method and total probabilities under an independence assumption.
Historical marginal-only records are labeled as incomplete; no invented joint forecasts are backfilled into the prospective record.

priority_order.name: Correct the inputs that favor implausible longshots
work: Compare method and duration probabilities with sufficiently complete, contemporaneous market prices while excluding the entry book from the reference where feasible.
Measure forecast accuracy and realized returns by odds range and method on later cards than the training data; do not pick odds cutoffs from the 27 settled method wagers.
Evaluate market-anchored and calibrated joint probabilities, with uncertainty represented by complete scenario distributions rather than unrelated probability floors.
Stress-test common model error, adverse price changes and unavailable books. Large raw estimated returns alone do not justify a larger stake.
acceptance: The longshot and submission estimates must improve on held-out future cards before they can justify increased exposure.
Any calibration or market adjustment preserves a coherent joint probability distribution and pre-fight provenance.

priority_order.name: Optimize all stakes in a fight together
work: Maximize conservative expected log bankroll growth across complete scenarios, with cash as an allowed choice and the shared exposure limits from step 1.
Evaluate an additional bet by its contribution to the existing portfolio, not by standalone EV or standalone Kelly size.
Test nominal joint Kelly, fractional joint Kelly and an uncertainty-aware joint objective as explicitly separate candidates; choose settings before the prospective comparison.
Allow multiple selections, or one, or none. Do not impose an arbitrary minimum number of selections or a rule that every positive-EV price must be funded.
Report combined worst-case fight loss, plausible drawdown and total stake alongside the selections.
acceptance: Duplicate identical bets do not manufacture diversification or double the optimal exposure.
Mutually exclusive outcomes can both receive stakes when doing so improves the combined objective.
A second positive-EV bet can be rejected when it worsens the portfolio's growth or violates limits.
One-fight budgets cannot be independently optimized against the same unreserved card bankroll.

priority_order.name: Compare strategies at the same risk budget before promotion
work: Keep the current highest-EV single pick, best conservative single pick, equal-budget split and joint optimizer as separate frozen comparisons, alongside cash and a market-only baseline where supported.
Use identical accessible prices, capture times, available funds, eligibility and aggregate exposure caps; preserve all alternatives and reasons for skipping them.
Track net bankroll growth, return on amount risked, worst fight/card exposure, drawdown, closing-price movement and sensitivity to price deterioration.
Calculate uncertainty with whole fight cards kept together; multiple selections on a fight and repeated snapshots are not independent evidence.
Predeclare a review floor of 20 settled cards and 200 settled fights for the prospective portfolio experiment. This is an operational review point, not proof or an automatic promotion trigger.
Promote only with stable probability accuracy and convincing net improvement after price stress at matched risk; otherwise keep the existing comparison policy and gather more data.
acceptance: The new rule's gains must not be explained solely by more total money risked.
Settings are frozen before scoring new cards; historical diagnostics are not presented as new prospective performance.
Missing quotes, missing joint forecasts and passes remain distinct.
